places.name: Osaka Castle
places.ai_summary: A historic castle surrounded by a beautiful park, showcasing the history of Osaka.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on New Year’s Day.

places.place_tip: Visit during cherry blossom season for stunning views.

places.name: Dotonbori District
places.ai_summary: A vibrant entertainment area known for its neon lights, street food, and nightlife.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the full experience.

places.place_tip: Try the local takoyaki and okonomiyaki from street vendors.

places.name: Shinsaibashi Shopping Street
places.ai_summary: A famous shopping area with a wide range of shops, from high-end boutiques to local souvenirs.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary by store; some may open earlier or close later.

places.place_tip: Look for the iconic Glico Man sign and try local snacks.

places.name: Universal Studios Japan
places.ai_summary: A popular theme park featuring rides and attractions based on movies produced by Universal Pictures.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary by season and day; check the official website before visiting.

places.place_tip: Purchase tickets online in advance to save time.

places.name: Umeda Sky Building
places.ai_summary: A landmark skyscraper with a floating garden observatory, offering panoramic views of Osaka.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 10:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Visit the observatory for stunning views of the city skyline.

attribution.title: 2018 Umeda Sky Building
attribution.author: Kakidai
attribution.description: Umeda Sky Building (Kita-ku, Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture)

places.name: Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan
places.ai_summary: One of the world's largest aquariums, featuring a diverse range of marine life and interactive exhibits.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 7:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the interactive touch pools and the underwater tunnel.

attribution.title: Kaiyukan
attribution.author: Teddy Yoshida (Harajuku at English Wikipedia)

places.name: Sumiyoshi Taisha Shrine
places.ai_summary: A historic Shinto shrine known for its unique architecture and beautiful gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Closed during the New Year holidays.

places.best_time_to_visit: Early morning, especially during the New Year
places.place_tip: Participate in the traditional New Year rituals if visiting in January.

places.name: Kuromon Ichiba Market
places.ai_summary: A bustling market known for its fresh seafood, produce, and street food stalls.
places.cost: Free (cost of food and goods varies)

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Wednesdays.

places.place_tip: Sample fresh sushi, sashimi, and other local delicacies.

places.name: Tennoji Park & Zoo
places.ai_summary: A spacious park featuring a zoo, botanical garden, and cultural facilities.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays (zoo only).

places.place_tip: Visit the zoo's giant panda and the park's beautiful cherry blossoms.

places.name: Abeno Harukas Observatory
places.ai_summary: The highest building in Japan, with an observatory offering breathtaking views of Osaka and beyond.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission at 9:30 PM.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the panoramic views and visit the art gallery on the same floor.

places.name: Namba Yasaka Shrine
places.ai_summary: A unique shrine famous for its giant lion head-shaped stage and vibrant festivals.

opening_hours.notes: Closed during the New Year holidays.

places.place_tip: Visit during the Toka Ebisu Festival in January for a lively experience.

places.name: Osaka Science Museum
places.ai_summary: An interactive science museum with hands-on exhibits, a planetarium, and an IMAX theater.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays (or the following day if Monday is a holiday).

places.place_tip: Check out the special exhibitions and the rooftop observatory.

places.name: Osaka Museum of History
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing Osaka's rich history through interactive exhibits and historical artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Tuesdays (or the following day if Tuesday is a holiday).

places.place_tip: Visit the rooftop for a panoramic view of Osaka Castle and the city.
places.address: Osaka Museum of History, Osaka, Japan

places.name: Tempozan Giant Ferris Wheel
places.ai_summary: A large Ferris wheel offering stunning views of Osaka Bay and the city skyline.

opening_hours.notes: Closed during strong winds or storms.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the Osaka Aquarium, located nearby.

places.name: Shitenno-ji Temple
places.ai_summary: One of Japan's oldest temples, known for its beautiful gardens and historic significance.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Wednesdays.

places.place_tip: Explore the temple grounds and the beautiful garden.

places.name: Hep Five Ferris Wheel
places.ai_summary: A prominent Ferris wheel in Osaka, located on the rooftop of the Hep Five shopping mall.

opening_hours.notes: Operating hours may vary; check in advance.

places.place_tip: Enjoy shopping at the Hep Five mall before or after your ride.

places.name: Nakanoshima Park
places.ai_summary: A scenic park located between two rivers, featuring walking paths, gardens, and a museum.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Visit the Nakanoshima Museum of Art located within the park.

places.name: Hozenji Yokocho Alley
places.ai_summary: A historic alleyway lined with traditional shops and restaurants, preserving Osaka's old-town atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a nostalgic atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Try the local delicacies at the traditional restaurants.

places.name: Expo ’70 Commemorative Park
places.ai_summary: A large park commemorating the 1970 World Expo, featuring gardens, museums, and a Japanese garden.
places.cost: Free (some attractions may have separate fees)

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays (or the following day if Monday is a holiday).

places.place_tip: Visit the Japan Pavilion and the beautiful rose garden.

places.name: Amerikamura District
places.ai_summary: A trendy district known for its youthful atmosphere, fashion boutiques, and street art.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the vibrant atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for unique fashion finds and street art.
